title: Social Media Executive
description:
Vishram Management Group is seeking a creative, data\-driven, and results\-oriented Social Media Executive with strong content strategy and platform management experience.

The selected candidate will work directly with the marketing/leadership team, take charge of the brand's day\-to\-day social media presence, analyze engagement and performance metrics, and support broader marketing and business growth initiatives.

We're hiring a Social Media Executive to own content creation and posting across our channels. You'll work closely with the Marketing Manager to bring campaign strategies to life — turning ideas into graphics, reels, and posts that go out consistently and on time. This role needs someone who can take a strategy and run with it independently, bringing fresh creative ideas rather than waiting to be told exactly what to make.

What You'll Do

Design graphics and create short\-form video content (reels) for LinkedIn, Instagram, and other channels

Plan and maintain a consistent posting calendar, ensuring content goes out on schedule

Collaborate closely with the Marketing Manager to translate campaign strategy into executed content

Bring original ideas for content formats, campaigns, and creative angles — not just execute a fixed brief

Monitor engagement and adjust content approach based on what's resonating

Keep a consistent brand voice and visual identity across all posts

Work independently, managing your own content pipeline with minimal day\-to\-day supervision

What You Bring

Proven experience creating graphics and short\-form video/reels for social platforms (portfolio or work samples required)

Comfort with design and editing tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar)

Strong creative eye \- an instinct for what makes content stop the scroll, not just check a box

Self\-directed working style; comfortable owning a calendar and deadlines without constant oversight

Clear communication skills to collaborate effectively with a remote Marketing Manager

Bonus: familiarity with B2B or professional\-services content (this isn't a consumer\-brand account — tone matters)

Pay: ₹290,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Position Title**


Principle Application Engineer – Customer Excellence

**Department**


Customer Success / Customer Excellence

**Reporting To**


Head of Customer Success

**Location**


Remote / Hybrid

**Travel**


Periodic travel to customer sites, industry events, and internal planning sessions

**POSITION OVERVIEW**


The Customer Excellence Manager (CEM) is responsible for helping strategic customers achieve measurable business and engineering outcomes through successful adoption of our simulation and engineering software solutions.


The CEM serves as the trusted advisor and primary post\-sales relationship owner, developing customer success plans, driving adoption initiatives, monitoring customer health and sentiment, and ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment.


The ideal candidate combines strong CAE and engineering software knowledge with customer engagement, strategic account management, stakeholder alignment, and business acumen. This role requires close collaboration with Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, and Marketing teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while supporting retention and long\-term account growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Customer Success \& Value Realization:** Own customer success outcomes by driving product adoption, value realization, and achievement of customer business and engineering objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.
* **Strategic Customer Engagement:** Build trusted relationships with technical, management, and executive stakeholders, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate for customer success.
* **Customer Health \& Retention:** Monitor customer health, adoption trends, and sentiment to proactively identify risks, develop recovery plans, and support long\-term customer retention.
* **Account Planning \& Growth:** Collaborate with Sales and Account Teams to contribute customer insights, support account planning activities, and identify opportunities for product adoption, expansion, and growth.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Coordinate activities across Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Represent customer needs and feedback within the organization, helping influence product priorities, adoption strategies, and customer experience improvements.
* **Executive Business Reviews \& Governance:** Lead customer governance discussions and business reviews that demonstrate value, align stakeholders, identify opportunities, and strengthen strategic relationships.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Develop customer champions and advocates who can participate in reference programs, industry events, case studies, and other strategic engagement initiatives.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

**Experience**
--------------

* 5\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Business Development, Application Engineering, Technical Consulting, Pre\-Sales, or Account Management within engineering software, CAE, simulation, PLM, CAD, or related technology industries.
* Experience managing strategic customer relationships and driving long\-term adoption programs.
* Experience conducting customer reviews, executive engagements, and technical discussions with multiple stakeholder levels.
* Proven history of supporting customer retention, adoption growth, and business expansion initiatives.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Strong customer\-centric mindset.
* Strategic account planning and stakeholder management.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance customer engagement, adoption, reporting, and productivity.
* Executive communication and presentation skills.
* Customer health and sentiment management.
* Value realization and adoption planning.
* Cross\-functional leadership and influence without authority.
* Analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong business and commercial acumen.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Tools \& Platforms**
----------------------

* CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight.
* Bring AI expertise
* Customer adoption and engagement analytics tools.
* Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
=====================================

* **Customer Outcomes:** Achievement of customer success plan objectives; customer adoption and utilization growth; successful onboarding and adoption milestones.
* **Customer Health:** Customer health score improvements; customer sentiment and relationship strength; risk identification and mitigation effectiveness.
* **Retention \& Growth:** Customer retention rate; contribution to Net Revenue Retention (NRR); expansion opportunities identified and supported; renewal readiness and account stability.
* **Customer Advocacy:** Customer references and success stories generated; product feedback submitted and acted upon; participation in advocacy and community initiatives.
* **Operational \& Reporting:** Accurate customer planning, reporting, and cross\-functional execution.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
===========================

**A successful candidate will be a technically credible CAE professional who can build trusted relationships, drive customer adoption, influence cross\-functional teams, manage customer sentiment, contribute to account planning, and identify business growth opportunities while ensuring customers achieve measurable engineering and business outcomes.**

 **What you'll be doing**


Own the Quality Governance capability, defining enterprise quality standards, managing release quality gates, and tracking defect metrics to continuously improve delivery quality across engineering teams.

* Define and own enterprise quality standards and QA methodologies across engineering teams, ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Manage release quality gates, governing entry and exit criteria so releases meet defined quality and business requirements before go\-live.
* Track and analyze defect metrics and quality analytics using tools such as TestRail to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
* Own release management from a quality perspective, ensuring quality sign\-off and release readiness across releases.
* Own UAT readiness, quality sign\-off, and post\-release defect triage for major launches, ensuring business and technical stakeholders have clear entry and exit criteria.
* Lead and develop the QA team, set technical direction, mentoring engineers, and building QA capability.
* Report quality posture, release risk, and defect trends to engineering leadership through concise dashboards and agreed improvement actions.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to embed quality practices early in the SDLC and report on quality posture to leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement of QA processes, incorporating AI\-assisted defect analytics and predictive quality insights to prioritize testing effort.
* Plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end\-to\-end, and regression testing for assigned scope.

**What you’ll need to succeed**


* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in quality engineering and QA, including defining quality standards and managing release quality gates.
* Strong command of QA standards, QA methodologies, release management, and defect analytics, with hands\-on experience using tools such as TestRail.
* Proven experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and driving continuous improvement in delivery quality.

description:

HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.



Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager with 8\+ years in B2B marketing operations to own campaign execution and lead lifecycle management across our martech stack. You'll bring an AI\-first approach to the role, using AI tools to speed up campaign builds, QA, and reporting, while working hands\-on in Marketo, Salesforce, LeanData, and Qualified. You'll partner with marketing, sales, and RevOps to keep campaigns accurate, scalable, and tied to pipeline results.


**What you'll do**

* Own end\-to\-end campaign builds \- email, nurture, webinar, digital, and integrated programs \- in Marketo and Salesforce, including landing pages, forms, segmentation, and reporting
* Standardize templates, naming conventions, and QA processes to keep campaigns scalable and error\-free
* Translate requirements from marketing and sales stakeholders into execution plans

* Manage Marketo\-Salesforce sync, Salesforce campaign structures, and attribution reporting
* Own lead lifecycle management: scoring, routing, segmentation, nurture workflows
* Troubleshoot sync and integration issues; partner with RevOps and Sales on process alignment


**Data Governance \& Reporting**


* Maintain data hygiene, deduplication, and segmentation standards with SalesOps
* Build and maintain dashboards tracking funnel conversion (MEL, MQL to Opportunity), influenced pipeline, and ROI in Salesforce and other supporting systems.
* Turn campaign and funnel data into recommendations that improve conversion and efficiency


**Process \& Martech Management**


* Document SOPs and playbooks; automate manual work where possible
* Support the broader martech stack (webinar platforms, enrichment, intent tools) and evaluate new capabilities


**What we are looking for**


* 8\+ years in marketing operations, campaign operations, or marketing automation

* AI\-first mindset \- comfortable using AI tools to speed up campaign execution, QA, and reporting

* Understanding of APIs, integrations, and marketing data flows
* Exposure to attribution and revenue reporting frameworks; basic SQL a plus

* Own end\-to\-end campaign execution with direct impact on pipeline and revenue
* Build expertise in martech and scalable marketing systems
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to drive data\-led GTM decisions
* Enjoy a holistic compensation package that rewards performance and potential, encompassing competitive salary, incentives (bonus and equity), comprehensive benefits, and career development.
